name: Egide S.A.
summary: Egide S.A., through its affiliates, specializes in the development, production, and distribution of hermetically sealed casings designed to protect and connect various electronic and photonic chips. The company's market reach extends globally, encompassing France, the broader European Union, and North America. Its product range includes diverse package types such as ceramic-to-metal, glass-to-metal, high-temperature cofired ceramic, power, optoelectronic, and microwave/RF solutions, alongside various inks. Furthermore, Egide supplies materials for thermal management, specific metallic components like molybdenum copper and copper tungsten, glass beads, and surface finishing services. The company caters to key sectors including defense and aerospace, telecommunications, civil aviation, security and industrial applications, and energy. Established in 1986, Egide S.A. has its headquarters in Bollène, France.
